post.originalText:
Opus 5.5, one prompt: "Build a 45-second machine that plays an original piece of music, where every note comes from a visible collision."

One HTML file, 47 KB. No images, no audio files. Every sound is synthesized in the browser.

Sound on. https://t.co/BkfbEaWspw

sourceMaterials.text: @LeeWyattCorp Thanks! Now I'm curious, what's the one bug you never fixed and just learned to live with :)
sourceMaterials.author: KamStudioLabs

sourceMaterials.text: Opus 5.5, third prompt: "Make a 45-second silent short film with no dialogue, where sound tells half the story. Invent the story."  It made a lighthouse keeper. The rain, the steps, the clock and the score are all synthesized in the browser. https://t.co/RGuaDmd7PJ
sourceMaterials.author: KamStudioLabs
